name: MEV bot 0x0ad8 unprotected arbitrary call
summary: The bot exposed a public entry point that executed caller-supplied calldata with no access control, letting the attacker make it pull 91,638 USDC out of a companion contract that had approved it.
notes: The directly executed bot exposed the arbitrary external-call path at deployment and its runtime remained byte-identical through exploitation.
The exploit receipt records one USDC transfer of 91,638.112249 from companion contract 0x211b6a1137bf539b2750e02b9e525cf5757a35ae to the attacker.
